explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/602 (Komjáth): for a family of countably infinite sets with pairwise intersections finite and of size ≠ 1, is there a 2-colouring of ∪A_i with no A_i monochromatic? Open; the forum gives only partial results (Bernstein, Miller). The statement quantifies over an arbitrary ground type α, which is equivalent to colouring ∪A_i since colours outside the union are irrelevant. The hypotheses are countable and infinite, finite intersections, and ncard ≠ 1, with the conclusion HasPropertyB. Repeated sets are excluded automatically because their intersection is infinite. Faithful.
